annotations.title: Read a deck and what changed

description: Use this to read one deck and what changed in it, for example what a company updated in its latest investor presentation. Give it the deck id or 6ix.com link from get_company_decks or search_decks, and slides: "1-5", "changed" or "all" to include slide text. Returns what changed from the company's previous version (new, updated and removed slides, figures that changed) and every slide's title, with its text when asked. Slide text comes in parts of about 40,000 characters (the answer says which part of how many): ask for part 2 and on, or pass nextCursor as cursor, to read the rest.

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

deck.description: The deck's id or its 6ix.com link (6ix.com/deck/…)

part.description: Which part of the slide text to read (default 1); the answer says how many there are

slides.description: Slides whose text to include: "1-5,12", "changed" (new and updated slides) or "all"

name: get_deck

whatChanged.description: What changed from the company's previous version of this deck

hasMore.description: Later parts follow: ask for part + 1, or pass nextCursor as cursor

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next part; null after the last part

parts.description: How many parts the whole text has

hasText.description: false: 6ix holds no text for this slide (an image or chart only)

text.description: This part's piece of the slide's text (the whole text when textComplete)

textComplete.description: This piece is the slide's whole text

textLength.description: Length of the slide's whole text

textRange.description: Where this piece sits in the slide's whole text (end excluded)

textStopsAt.description: The slide's stored text is longer than 6ix reads here; it stops at this many characters

textStoredCut.description: 6ix stored only the first 4,000 characters of this slide's text when it read the deck; the slide says more (see its image on 6ix)

storedCutSlides.description: Slides whose text 6ix stored only in part (the first 4,000 characters)

textNotStored.description: Characters of slide text the deck holds that 6ix did not store (0 when it stored all of it)

version.description: Changes when the stored text changes; parts of one version join into the whole text

title: Read a deck and what changed
